note: Fixed topic list for the Topic filter. The AI step may only pick ids from this list; each hint tells it what belongs where. Edit labels freely; changing ids or hints re-tags every project on the next run.

topics.label: AI & machine learning
topics.hint: Building, training or testing AI models: machine learning, neural networks, LLMs, computer vision. Not studies of how people react to AI (that is hci).

topics.label: Software, apps & web
topics.hint: Writing software: web apps, mobile apps, games engines, simulation software, tools.

topics.label: Electronics, devices & robotics
topics.hint: Hardware: circuits, sensors, embedded systems, wearables, prosthetics, robots, mechanical design.

topics.label: Human–computer interaction
topics.hint: How people use, trust or are affected by technology, including AI chatbots, explainable AI from the user's side, accessibility tech and digital tools.

topics.label: Materials & chemistry
topics.hint: New materials, polymers, coatings, chemical formulation, chemistry lab work.

topics.label: Physics, optics & space
topics.hint: Physics, optics, photonics, plasmonics, fluid dynamics, plume and space physics.

topics.label: Biology & life sciences
topics.hint: Plants, microbes, cells, animals, molecular biology, microbiology, anatomy.

topics.label: Environment & climate
topics.hint: Climate, air quality, wildfires, agriculture and crop health, sustainability.

topics.label: Health & medicine
topics.hint: Patients, clinical or public health, nursing, caregiving, aging, disease, falls.

topics.label: Exercise & movement science
topics.hint: Physical activity, body composition, gait, kinesiology, strength and fitness.

topics.label: Psychology & the brain
topics.hint: Cognition, behavior, decision-making, language processing, emotion, neuroscience, EEG.

topics.label: Education & accessibility
topics.hint: Teaching, learning, students' experiences, disability and accessibility on campus.

topics.label: Society, law & security
topics.hint: Criminal justice, law and policy, violence, insurgent groups, security studies, social issues.

topics.label: Animation, art & games
topics.hint: Animated films, 3D modeling, digital art, game art and design, creative media.
